title: Case: Part of a two-carton desk order has not arrived
context: Order TG-2141 was shipped as two separately labelled cartons. Both show delivery scans from the same day, made at different times and in different ways.
initial_request: Only half of TG-2141 has shown up. Your tracking says the whole lot is delivered. Where is the rest? I took a day off work for this and I'm not paying for a desk I can't build.

events.body:
Thanks,
Piran
--
Sent from my phone. This email and any attachments are confidential and intended solely for the addressee.

TG-2141 for Xanthe Blackwood left us today as two cartons on separate labels: DL-1137 standing desk frame (long flat carton, 31 kg) and DL-6462 desk top (square carton, 18 kg). Both handed to Tumblewell Arc at 15:10.
Route plan for depot HL-6 published for Monday. 25 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.

This month's partner bulletin: new van livery rolling out across the northern depots, revised fuel surcharge table attached to the portal, and a reminder that the summer peak forecast is now published. To stop receiving these emails, update your preferences.

End of day status for TG-2141. DL-1137: delivery scan 2028-04-05 10:12, driver note 'left in porch'. DL-6462: delivery scan 2028-04-05 15:47, different driver, note 'handed to resident'. Both closed on our side.
Hi, any update on DL-79102? It was meant to come Monday. Thanks.
Only half of TG-2141 has shown up. Your tracking says the whole lot is delivered. Where is the rest? I took a day off work for this and I'm not paying for a desk I can't build.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask which of the two cartons has arrived: the desk frame (DL-1137) or the desk top (DL-6462).

must: Asks Xanthe Blackwood which carton has arrived and which is missing, naming the desk frame (DL-1137) and the desk top (DL-6462) or their label references
Sends the question to Xanthe Blackwood before any trace is requested
Avoids stating that the missing carton is lost, stolen or delivered
must_not: Asks the Parcel trace team or Dispatch to trace DL-1137 on the assumption that the porch-drop carton is the missing one
Tells Xanthe Blackwood that the missing carton was delivered, or that it is lost or stolen
Promises a refund, a replacement or a redelivery date
Asks for anything beyond which carton arrived, such as proof of identity, a door code or payment details
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: I am sorry part of your order is missing. TG-2141 was sent as two cartons with their own labels: the desk frame (long flat carton, label DL-1137) and the desk top (square carton, label DL-6462). Please tell me which one you have received, or the DL number on the label of the carton that did arrive. With that I can ask the carrier to trace the right one. I cannot say yet where the other carton is.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-302: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. 4 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
